newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentina's Banco del Suquia buys Bica.
newsitem.headline: Argentina's Banco del Suquia buys Bica.

text.p: Argentina's Banco del Suquia said Friday it had bought local bank Banco Bica for $60 million.

A company spokesman corrected an earlier statement giving the price as $600 million. The bank said it was buying Bica "with the objective of strengthening its position as a multi-regional bank with a strong presence in the central regions of the country."
The acquisition of Banco Bica will raise Suquia's portfolio of deposits to $960 million from $700 million. Prior to the purchase, Suquia was the country's tenth largest bank in terms of deposits.
Suquia will now have 85 branch offices, compared with 47 previously. Its total assets will increase to $1.50 billion from $1.07 billion.
The statement said Banco de Suquia is currently going through an "important process of consolidation and growth in its business," including strengthening of the corporate banking sector.
